profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at ServiceNow
profile.summary: I am a graduate from the University of California, San Diego with a degree in Computer Engineering. I enjoy challenging myself with new and interesting projects. I am eager to strengthen my professional skills by taking on greater responsibilities and by continuing to gain work experience in the industry. My current interests include front-end web development, but I'm quickly learning to become a full-stack web developer through my experience with ServiceNow and side web projects. Thanks for stopping by!

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Full-stack web development using Java (backend) and JavaScript (frontend and backend) with emphasis on NodeJS, React JS, SASS
- Responsible for managing and coordinating the team's development environment and code repositories using GitHub Enterprise
- Current ServiceNow ITSM projects include: ITSM Virtual Agent, Walk-Up, Embedded Help, and Service Portfolio Management
- Colead the front-end redesign, architecture, and implementation effort for the new Service Portfolio Management product

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description:
- Implemented and maintained core features on ServiceNow Express product
- Projects include: Angular front-end redesign, REST APIs, Machine Learning and AI prototyping
- In charge of maintaining all development code repositories for the team (GitHub)
- Technologies include: JavaScript, HTML, CSS, AngularJS, Java, Python

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern - Platform Development
positions.description:
- Implemented new platform functionality using ServiceNow Script API and Java
- Performed bug fixes on ServiceNow's Internationalization software
- Added user experience improvements on ServiceNow Express using front-end technologies: HTML, CSS, Javascript, and jQuery

positions.title: IT Intern, Performance Engineering & Testing
positions.description:
- MyEnergy Log Analysis – Analyzed millions of customer data logs and provided key metrics
- Extracted key information that lead to performance optimization of the MyEnergy website by 10%
- Created a log analyzing user interface using Perl – features: sorting, data metric extraction, and parsing
- Streamlined performance engineer’s custom data collecting scripts into a collective user interface using R programming
- Upgraded and maintained the team’s load generator servers and Performance Center troubleshooting

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Performed testing of insulin pump devices through a comprehensive and strict verification protocol
- Utilized JTAG debugging software tools for the software validation and testing of high tech insulin pump, t:slim (Arm Cortex & MSP430)
- Developed a Linux shell script application tool that automates the assembly and compilation of the product's application build files
- Script is used by the fellow engineers and quality assurance to create new device builds for software verification

positions.title: Tutor
positions.description:
-Team of 13 people tutored a class of 190 students and graded programming assignments 
-Assisted students with instructions and programming assignments - debug code, answer questions, etc.
-Intro to Java Lab - Winter 2012, Intro to Object Oriented Programming – Spring 2012

positions.title: Marine Technology Society Intern
positions.description:
-Project Objective: to overhaul and automate the manual pressure calibration system for sensitive oceanographic instruments
-Designed, assembled and programmed the electronic valve prototype which controlled the output air pressure used in the calibration process

projects.title: Place-its Android App
projects.description:
- Served as team lead for a team of 6 people on full cycle agile development of location-based reminders application 
- Organized and lead team meetings, delegated tasks to individuals, ensured completion of project deadlines
- Developed using Java (Eclipse IDE) with Google Android SDK, Google Maps API, Google App Engine
- Tested through BDD-style testing, JUnit, and full scenarios testing

projects.title: IEEE Micromouse Robotics Competition
projects.description:
- Small autonomous maze solving robotics competition (May 2013)
- Low level embedded programming on Arduino Due Chip with ARM processor
- Use of GNU toolchain and JTAG interface to program chip to control stepper motor drivers, sensors, interrupt handlers, memory management
- Developed the maze solving algorithm with emphasis on reliability and efficiency
